```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(rstan)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
df <- read.csv("BattingAverage.csv")
```

# (1)
```{r}
cat("Total number of players: ", nrow(df), "\n")

pos_summary <- df %>%
  group_by(PriPos) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = n(), 
    Median_AtBats = median(AtBats)
  )

print(pos_summary)
```

# (2)
```{r}
ggplot(df, aes(x = reorder(PriPos, AtBats, FUN = median), y = AtBats)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of At-Bats by Primary Position",
    x = "Primary Position",
    y = "Number of At-Bats"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

# (3)
```{r}
positions_factor <- as.factor(df$PriPos)
position_index <- as.numeric(positions_factor)

stan_data <- list(
  N = nrow(df),
  C = length(unique(position_index)),
  pos = position_index,
  hits = df$Hits,
  at_bats = df$AtBats
)
```


# (4)
```{r}
stan_code <- "
data {
  int<lower=1> N; 
  int<lower=1> C; 
  array[N] int<lower=1, upper=C> pos; 
  array[N] int<lower=0> hits;     
  array[N] int<lower=0> at_bats;     
}

parameters {
  real<lower=0, upper=1> omega;
  real<lower=0> kappa_minus_2;

  vector<lower=0, upper=1>[C] omega_c;
  vector<lower=0>[C] kappa_c_minus_2;

  vector<lower=0, upper=1>[N] theta;
}

transformed parameters {
  real kappa = kappa_minus_2 + 2;
  vector[C] kappa_c = kappa_c_minus_2 + 2;
}

model {
  omega ~ beta(1, 1);
  kappa_minus_2 ~ gamma(0.01, 0.01);

  omega_c ~ beta(omega * (kappa - 2) + 1, (1 - omega) * (kappa - 2) + 1);
  kappa_c_minus_2 ~ gamma(0.01, 0.01);

  for (s in 1:N) {
    theta[s] ~ beta(omega_c[pos[s]] * (kappa_c[pos[s]] - 2) + 1,
                    (1 - omega_c[pos[s]]) * (kappa_c[pos[s]] - 2) + 1);
  }

  hits ~ binomial(at_bats, theta);
}"
```

# (5)
```{r}
fit <- stan(
  model_code = stan_code,
  data = stan_data,
  iter = 2500, 
  chains = 4, 
  seed = 451
)

fit_summary <- summary(fit)$summary

theta_rows <- grep("^theta", rownames(fit_summary))
theta_ess <- fit_summary[theta_rows, "n_eff"]
min_ess_theta <- min(theta_ess)

cat("Minimum ESS for theta parameters: ", min_ess_theta, "\n")
```



# (6)
```{r}
total_current_iters <- 4 * 2500 / 2 
required_iters <- total_current_iters * (10000 / min_ess_theta)
cat("Estimated iterations needed for ESS >= 10,000: ", required_iters, "\n")
```


# (7)
```{r}
theta_summary <- fit_summary[theta_rows, c("mean", "sd", "2.5%", "97.5%")]
head(theta_summary)
```

# (8)
```{r}
pairs(fit, pars = c("omega", "kappa", "omega_c[1]", "kappa_c[1]"))
```

# (9)
```{r}
posterior_samples <- rstan::extract(fit)
theta_abad <- posterior_samples$theta[, 1]
theta_altuve <- posterior_samples$theta[, 10]

diff_players <- theta_altuve - theta_abad

cat("Mean difference in batting ability (Altuve - Abad): ", mean(diff_players), "\n")
cat("95% Credible Interval: ", quantile(diff_players, c(0.025, 0.975)), "\n")
```

# (10)
```{r}
levels(positions_factor) 
idx_pitcher <- 7 
idx_2ndbase <- 2

omega_pitcher <- posterior_samples$omega_c[, idx_pitcher]
omega_2ndbase <- posterior_samples$omega_c[, idx_2ndbase]

diff_positions <- omega_2ndbase - omega_pitcher
cat("Mean diff in position batting ability (2nd Base - Pitcher): ", mean(diff_positions), "\n")
```
